title: Figures that preserve evidence
outcome: Explain figures that preserve evidence using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Draw bars that preserve the comparison. A report plots correct counts for two versions on the same ten cases.
given: A has 6/10 correct; B has 8/10. The count axis should start at zero and identify the ten-case denominator.

steps.label: Draw honest bars
steps.detail: Use heights 6 and 8 on a zero-based correct-count axis.

steps.label: Label the scale
steps.detail: State counts out of ten, not an unspecified quality score.

steps.label: Keep context nearby
steps.detail: Note the fixed tasks and absence of a significance test.

explanation: Figures make evidence easier to inspect when labels and scales preserve meaning. A dramatic-looking visual cannot supply missing uncertainty or representativeness.

counterfactual.change: Start the axis at 5 without making the truncation obvious.
counterfactual.prediction: The bars exaggerate the visual contrast and require correction or clear disclosure.
counterfactual.reason: Visible heights no longer correspond to the full count scale.

student_task: Draw count bars for 6/10 and 8/10 using the stated axis. Why must the denominator and fixed task context remain visible, and what distortion arises from an undisclosed axis start at five?
teacher_answer: Use heights 6 and 8 on a zero-based correct-count axis. State counts out of ten, not an unspecified quality score. Note the fixed tasks and absence of a significance test. Changed case: The bars exaggerate the visual contrast and require correction or clear disclosure. Visible heights no longer correspond to the full count scale.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: A well-labelled chart still cannot establish a causal or population claim from ten cases.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
